h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalandhar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Jalandhar

c: Jalandhar makes sports goods for players across India, so buyers here tend to know what good training equipment looks like. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, sports academies, housing colonies and public parks in Jalandhar. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,360 km away, and travel to Punjab by road.

Punjab has hot summers, a monsoon and cold, foggy winter mornings. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats keep the machines working through all three seasons. We send the equipment by road and install through our own team or a dealer in north India. Tell us the users you expect, whether players, students or older walkers. We will suggest strength and gentle machines in the right mix and send a layout drawing before anything is made.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit a sports academy?
items.a: Strength and core stations such as the ABB Trainer, Leg Extension and chest press machines. They use body weight and fit into warm-up and conditioning routines.

items.q: Can the machines stay outdoors through a Punjab winter?
items.a: Yes. The galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are made for outdoor use in heat and cold. Check bolts and moving parts at the change of season.
